status: awaiting owner review; concept only, no runtime changes
owner_feedback: Previous 01–04 designs rejected. Use original Pelag as basis, larger back-carried anchor, exact current saber, more rugged haircut and actual new menu style. Keep compatibility with existing animations.
prompt:
Edit and art-direct the ORIGINAL PELAG in reference image 1. This is a faithful evolution of this exact existing game hero, NOT a new costume or another character.

REFERENCE PRIORITY:
1) Image 1 is the PRIMARY EDIT TARGET, existing Pelag. Keep his recognizable face and facial structure, body proportions, head size, joint positions, warm skin, compact athletic physique, exact ivory crossover short-sleeve shirt, coral V-neck edging and waist sash with large diamond motif, restrained turquoise edge accents, ivory knee-length loose trousers, plain brown wrist bracers and brown sandals. These clothes and anatomy must remain visibly the same. No new jacket, vest, collar, cape, armour, extra belts, long coat, black trousers or dark outfit. Existing animation compatibility is essential: unchanged skeleton proportions and garment envelope.
2) Image 2 is the EXACT CURRENT SABER to use, not a loose suggestion. Reproduce its broad curved silver blade and distinctive stepped spine, small gold crossguard with a central red diamond gem, turquoise ferrule, brown wrapped grip crossed by red wrap, golden/turquoise pommel and short coral cloth ties. No D-shaped pirate guard, no generic cutlass, no straight sword. This is the same sword he already uses.
3) Image 3 is the APPROVED ANCHOR and chain design. Preserve this shape and sturdy ring/chain/grip construction, but make the anchor head a substantial heavy combat weapon about 0.95m high and 0.6m across for this ~1.78m hero. It is CARRIED DIAGONALLY ON HIS BACK on a simple brown strap, visibly large: ring near one shoulder, broad curved flukes near opposite hip, clear of knees. Heavy broad brushed steel planes, tangible thickness, proper interlocking chain links. Not a small belt charm. Exactly one attached anchor on each depicted view, no fused weapon/anatomy.
4) Image 4 is the actual approved NEW MAIN MENU. Bring the CHARACTER RENDERING into this art direction: expressive painted volumes, storm-blue smoked shadows, warm ivory highlights, muted ember/coral accents, mineral silver edges, confident broad brush transitions, dramatic but readable values, matte tactile cloth, atmospheric elegance. Not simply the previous glossy cartoon character pasted on a smoky background. Render the hero himself with a more painterly, grounded, rugged material treatment while preserving his identity and outfit. Face should retain the same features, with a focused serious look and more decisive painted planes, not cute glossy baby cheeks.

ONLY MAJOR PHYSICAL CHANGE: NEW RUGGED SHORT HAIRCUT. Dark-brown very short cropped sides and nape, compact coarse textured crop on top (3–4cm), pushed slightly back, blunt broken clumps, restrained low silhouette. Keep the original coral headband with the single pale diamond, integrated naturally across the forehead; short cropped hair clearly visible above and at temples. Absolutely no long side fringe, fluffy anime spikes, coiffed high pompadour, ponytail, topknot or white streak. Masculine practical battle haircut, distinctly different from the original shaggy hair. Do not age him into a bearded old man or change his anatomy.

PRESENTATION: one polished wide landscape hero concept plate, NOT multiple variants. Main full-body front three-quarter depiction filling left 60%, sturdy relaxed upright stance very close to original A-pose, holding the exact saber low in his right hand with the blade fully visible and naturally angled outward. Anchor visible behind shoulder/hip. Right upper area: portrait close-up to inspect the new short haircut and same recognizable face. Right lower area: matching full-body rear three-quarter view clearly showing the back anchor and original outfit. All views must depict precisely the same design. Keep both feet and saber tip in frame with breathing room. Storm-blue smoky painted backdrop echoing the menu, subtle warm light accents outside the silhouette, full character clearly illuminated, no obtrusive fog covering the legs. Outfit stays ivory and coral, NOT black. No new symbols, no captions, no logo. Large readable shapes, very sparse wear, no tiny stitch/rivet/patch noise. No VFX on the sword or anchor, no flames glued to clothing. This must unmistakably be the ORIGINAL PELAG from image 1, with short rugged hair, original sword and an impressive heavy anchor.
